scope: complete one-pass held-out grid and scoped development/held-out synthetic interpretation; no intervention or real-data validation

bundle.storage: local external bundle; raw generated outputs and consumed opening claim remain outside Git

verification.independent_summary_reconstruction: all 37 endpoints, paired differences, interactions, descriptive means/ranges and null counts from saved records, without tracker re-execution

limitations: Six fixed toy paths across two splits; noise seeds are not independent camera sites.
Severe imposed box errors overlap the crossing period; no real detector or traffic prevalence is measured.
Perspective alone preserves primary count and ID outcomes here, not all localization outcomes or all domains.
Mixed interactions and secondary-anchor outcomes do not select a winner or improvement.
Opened held-out inputs cannot serve as untouched acceptance evidence for a later tuned intervention.
Hashes establish evidence consistency, not independent scientific validity or universal numerical parity.
